name: PR detail shows the seeded intent card, and out-of-scope findings carry their scope badge
description: Opens PR #482 and checks the seeded pr_intent (L03 intent layer, spec specs/intent-layer.md): the summary, the 'N in-scope items' named list, the risk-area chip, the confidence badge and the missing-context notice (specs/ratelimit.md). Then switches to the Agent runs tab and checks that the seeded N+1 finding shows the 'Out of scope' badge and 'downgraded from WARNING'. Read-only seeded data: never clicks Re-classify / Detect intent (that calls the LLM). Waits for the PR row text before clicking (list fetch race, see e2e/INSIGHTS.md) and uses --exact for list names. Assumes a freshly-seeded DB (run via ./scripts/e2e.sh).
